entities.description: A segmented editorial unit inside a Document: headline, dateline, full text, page range, canonical link for syndication.

entities.name: Passage
entities.description: A citable contiguous text span of an Article with exact character offsets, the unit indexed and retrieved.

entities.name: AuthorityTier
entities.description: Ranked credibility rubric owned by the corpus: official-statistics, legislation, scientific-study, institutional-statement, press-report, other. Published as published language so retrieval consumes it instead of redefining trust.

entities.name: Provenance
entities.description: Immutable locator bundle: document id, article id, page number, character offset, source URI, retrieval timestamp.

entities.name: ExtractionQuality
entities.description: Measured extraction health: method (native/ocr), confidence, missing-glyph rate, acceptance flag.

entities.name: CorpusCollection
entities.description: A named, versioned manifest of which documents and index version a run searched. A manifest, not a transactional aggregate over the whole corpus — it references documents, it does not contain them.

entities.name: RetrievalQuery
entities.description: Normalised search intent derived from a claim: claim text, entity and time filters, corpus snapshot. Not an aggregate — it is an input to an application operation, and the trace that matters is RetrievalTrace on the pack.

entities.name: EvidenceCandidate
entities.description: A retrieved Passage with stance label (supporting/contradicting/contextual), authority tier and component scores.

entities.name: EvidencePack
entities.description: The frozen, balanced bundle of candidates handed to an agent as justification for one claim.

entities.name: EvidenceScore
entities.description: Inspectable weighting: authority weight, lexical score, semantic similarity, recency weight, directness, final rank.

entities.name: StanceLabel
entities.description: Classification of a candidate relative to the claim: supporting, contradicting, contextual, tangential.

entities.name: RecencyPolicy
entities.description: Configurable decay function, reference date and minimum weight that operationalises 'current events outweigh history'.

entities.name: CoverageReport
entities.description: Measured evidence availability for a claim: candidate counts per stance, best authority found, gap flag.

entities.name: Stakeholder
entities.description: An institution participating in Austrian healthcare policy (social insurance, ministry, chamber, patient representation, hospital association).

entities.name: StakeholderProfile
entities.description: The negotiating character of a Stakeholder: mandate, interests, constraints, budget limits, decision priorities and red lines.

entities.name: Interest
entities.description: A stated goal the stakeholder optimises for, with weight and the policy topics it applies to.

entities.name: Constraint
entities.description: A hard limit (budget ceiling, legal competence, political feasibility) that a stakeholder cannot concede.

entities.name: BudgetLimit
entities.description: Numeric spending envelope with period and tolerance used to reject unacceptable proposals.

entities.name: DecisionPriority
entities.description: Ordered ranking the stakeholder applies when interests conflict.

entities.name: HistoricalPosition
entities.description: A documented past stance of the institution, derived from press/institutional sources with provenance and date.

entities.name: AgentBinding
entities.description: The immutable binding of a StakeholderProfile to an agent persona used in one simulation run, including persona rules and allowed evidence.

entities.name: InstitutionIdentity
entities.description: Canonical institutional name, category and short code used in all identifiers and outputs.

entities.name: SimulationRun
entities.description: One simulation of one policy question: pinned corpus snapshot, bound stakeholders, phase state machine, round cap and outcome.

entities.name: NegotiationMandate
entities.description: The moderator-issued framing of the question: objective, constraints, selected stakeholders, rules and stopping conditions.

entities.name: NegotiationRound
entities.description: A numbered turn cycle with per-stakeholder turns, closed by the moderator and scored for convergence.

entities.name: Position
entities.description: A stakeholder's stance on a conflict topic: proposal, claims, evidence refs, confidence and revision lineage.

entities.name: Argument
entities.description: A single turn's contribution: speaker, target, stance, claims, citations and a reference to the producing agent invocation.

entities.name: ArgumentStance
entities.description: Whether the argument supports, opposes, qualifies or conditionally accepts the target.

entities.name: ConflictTopic
entities.description: An identified point of institutional disagreement with per-stakeholder stance history and resolution status.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: A set of stakeholders on a conflict topic behind one explicit shared proposal, with a formed round and reasons.

entities.name: RevisionReason
entities.description: Structured justification of a position change: cited argument ids, evidence ids and stated driver.

entities.name: StoppingCondition
entities.description: The rule that ended the run: consensus threshold met, round cap reached, or deadlock declared.

entities.name: ConsensusRecord
entities.description: Per-conflict-topic outcome: consensus level, supporting and opposing stakeholders, threshold met or not.

entities.name: MajorityPosition
entities.description: The stance carried by the majority of weight-bearing stakeholders on a topic, with vote-like support listing.

entities.name: MinorityPosition
entities.description: A dissenting stance with its holders, arguments and unresolved objections.

entities.name: CompromisePackage
entities.description: A bundle of accepted cross-stakeholder proposal components with provenance and the rejected proposals list.

entities.name: ImpactAssessment
entities.description: Scenario effect estimates per package (e.g. waiting-time reduction, budget delta) with assumptions and uncertainty.

entities.name: SupportLevel
entities.description: Weighted measure of support for a proposal across stakeholders, derived from interests and stances.

entities.name: UncertaintyLabel
entities.description: Explicit statement of confidence basis for an estimate: evidenced, modelled, or assumed.

entities.name: UnresolvedConflict
entities.description: A conflict topic still open at run close, with the positions that remain apart.

entities.name: DecisionBrief
entities.description: A versioned, immutably persisted projection of one closed run. It is generated — it holds no input state of its own — but once published it is a first-class artefact with its own identity, version lineage and citation integrity.

entities.name: BriefSection
entities.description: One of the eight required components with ordering, content and the entities it projects.

entities.name: CitationReference
entities.description: A resolvable pointer from a brief statement to a Passage provenance with surrounding context.

entities.name: ActorSummary
entities.description: Institution, goals, constraints and positions adopted, as shown in the actors section.

entities.name: PositionTimeline
entities.description: Per-stakeholder stance trajectory across rounds, used for the position-change visualisation.

entities.name: BriefVersion
entities.description: Version marker linking a brief to the run id, corpus snapshot and generation timestamp.

entities.name: Claim
entities.description: An extracted assertion from an argument: text, type (quantitative, legal, causal, qualitative), measure, value, period, geography.

entities.name: ClaimVerification
entities.description: The verdict for a claim: supported, contradicted, unsupported, or ambiguous, with the source set and method.

entities.name: ContradictionFinding
entities.description: A detected conflict between two verified claims or between a claim and an authoritative figure, with both provenances.

entities.name: ClaimType
entities.description: Classification driving the required verification path: quantitative, legal, causal, qualitative.

entities.name: VerificationVerdict
entities.description: Enumerated outcome with confidence basis: supported, contradicted, unsupported, ambiguous.

entities.name: MeasureReference
entities.description: Normalised identity of a measurable quantity: measure name, unit, reference period, geography, population.

entities.name: ArticleSection
entities.description: Typed region of an Article: headline, standfirst, body, caption or quotation block. Drives directness scoring and quotation screening.

entities.name: QuotationBlock
entities.description: A span of quoted or reported speech with speaker attribution; structurally retained but never promoted as evidence because the challenge forbids quoting real persons.

entities.name: LanguageTag
entities.description: Language variant marker (de-AT, de-DE) governing tokenisation, compound-word handling and embedding model choice for German-language retrieval.

entities.name: CanonicalArticleRef
entities.description: Pointer from a syndicated duplicate to the canonical article that owns the citable passages, preventing duplicate coverage from inflating support.

entities.name: IngestionRun
entities.description: One batch ingestion execution over a shard of source files: documents attempted, accepted, quarantined, failed, with retry lineage and a terminal status. Makes corpus growth auditable and re-runs idempotent.

entities.name: IndexManifest
entities.description: Published index state for a corpus snapshot: indexed passages, embedding model, index version, searchable-since. Belongs to the corpus collection rather than being a second aggregate over the same material.

entities.name: AuthorityWeight
entities.description: Numeric weight looked up from the corpus-owned AuthorityTier rubric. Keeps the rubric owned by EvidenceCorpus while retrieval only consumes it.

entities.name: RetrievalTrace
entities.description: Reproducibility record attached to each pack: index manifest version, embedding and reranker model ids, query rewrite applied, candidate counts per stance.

entities.name: QueryRewrite
entities.description: Deterministic expansion applied to a German-language claim before search: compound splitting, umlaut folding, institutional synonym mapping.

entities.name: NegotiatingPower
entities.description: Derived leverage of an institution: mandate scope, budget authority, veto rights and coalition centrality. Drives game-theoretic reasoning instead of opinion averaging.

entities.name: VetoRight
entities.description: The class of proposals an institution can block outright (e.g. statutory benefit changes without insurer consent). A hard constraint on what consensus is reachable.

entities.name: Dependency
entities.description: Directional relation between two institutions — funding, approval, staffing, data provision — with strength and the proposal classes it affects.

entities.name: MandateScope
entities.description: The legally and institutionally admissible range of what the stakeholder may agree to; bounds every concession an agent can make.

entities.name: TurnAssignment
entities.description: A stakeholder's allocated floor in a round: position in turn order, the conflict topic, and whether the turn was used, passed or abstained.

entities.name: NegotiationPhase
entities.description: Monotonic process stage: position-formation, debate, negotiation, compromise, closure. Guards which commands are legal at a given moment.

entities.name: Proposal
entities.description: The structured substance of a position: measure, quantified effect with unit, target population, cost and affected stakeholders — what makes two positions machine-comparable.

entities.name: ProposalComponent
entities.description: One admissible part of a proposal (e.g. 'expand telemedicine for dermatology') carrying its own support record so packages can be assembled from accepted parts.

entities.name: CoalitionOffer
entities.description: A recorded invitation to join a shared proposal on a conflict topic, with the invited stakeholder, conditions, and accept/decline outcome.

entities.name: Scenario
entities.description: A counterfactual being assessed: baseline versus the measures of one CompromisePackage, its horizon, affected population and stated assumptions. Impact only means something relative to a scenario.

entities.name: FeasibilityRating
entities.description: Rated political, legal and administrative feasibility of a package with the basis for each rating; the third dimension the material demands alongside cost and acceptance.

entities.name: ConsensusThreshold
entities.description: The support level the mandate requires for consensus, together with how veto rights alter the effective bar.

entities.name: VetoBlockedOutcome
entities.description: Record of a proposal that met the support threshold but is not consensus because a bound stakeholder holds a blocking competence over its class.

entities.name: CitedStatement
entities.description: The atomic unit of the brief: one statement with its citation references, the claim ids it rests on, and whether it is evidenced, narrative or unsupported. Makes 'which claim does this sentence rest on' answerable per sentence.

entities.name: RejectedProposalRecord
entities.description: A measure that failed to gather support, with the stakeholders who blocked it and their stated reasons. The material explicitly requires 'proposals not implemented' as an output component.

entities.name: SimulationDisclaimer
entities.description: Statement of what the result is and is not: probabilistic agent reasoning over a pinned corpus, no determinism claim, no real-person positions.

entities.name: BriefComponentSlot
entities.description: Position of one mandated component among the eight, with its completion state; the structural guarantee that no component can be silently dropped.

entities.name: ReferenceFigure
entities.description: The canonical value of one MeasureReference taken from an authoritative source, with its as-of date and source tier. The baseline against which every agent claim in that measure is compared.

entities.name: ToleranceBand
entities.description: Admissible numeric deviation for a measure (rounding, revision, estimate spread) below which two figures are treated as equal.

entities.name: ExpertReview
entities.description: Escalation record for claims the deterministic checks cannot settle: the question asked, the evidence supplied, the verdict and its basis. The feedback loop the material requires for figures.

entities.name: RoundLearning
entities.description: Persisted digest of what one round taught the participants: arguments that withstood challenge, proposals that gained or lost support, coalitions formed, evidence that changed minds, and the position shifts it caused. This is the state the challenge requires so agents take partial results into subsequent rounds.

entities.name: LearningApplication
entities.description: Explicit link from a later argument or position revision to the RoundLearning insight it applies, with the insight type (evidence accepted, alliance shift, proposal weakened).

entities.name: LearningInsightType
entities.description: What kind of lesson was carried forward: challenger evidence accepted, own claim abandoned, coalition partner shifted, proposal support strengthened or weakened.

entities.name: MandateSource
entities.description: The authoritative instrument grounding a power claim: legal provision, statutory instrument, budget decision or institutional statute, with citation and as-of date. The source of truth the review demanded for veto rights, competences and budget authority.

entities.name: AttributionStrength
entities.description: How firmly a source attributes a stance to the institution: explicit attributed statement, reported institutional position, or mere mention. Governs whether a HistoricalPosition may be used.

entities.name: PowerSourceKind
entities.description: Classification of where an authority derives from: legislation, statutory instrument, budget decision, institutional statute, or negotiated agreement.

entities.name: EstimateBasis
entities.description: Provenance class of a quantitative estimate: measured, derived from authoritative figures, modelled by a stated method, assumed, or not estimated. The distinction the review demanded between evidence-backed calculation and LLM assumption.

entities.name: DerivationInput
entities.description: One enumerated input behind a derived figure: a ReferenceFigure id, a passage id, or a run-internal tally such as a stakeholder cost sum.

entities.name: EstimateLimitation
entities.description: Stated limitation of an estimate: what it ignores, what it assumes constant, and which population or period it does not cover.

entities.name: AbsenceFinding
entities.description: Recorded negative result for a stance: the queries issued, the corpus snapshot searched and the reason nothing met threshold. Turns 'no contradiction found' into an auditable fact rather than an omission or a blocker.

entities.name: SpeakerKind
entities.description: Who a statement is attributed to: institution, named person, anonymous source or unattributed. Decides whether a QuotationBlock is citable (institutional) or excluded (personal).

entities.name: AuthorityRule
entities.description: Claim-type-specific ordering of source types, replacing a single global authority scale. Legal questions rank legislation first, quantitative ones official statistics, causal ones studies.

entities.name: VerificationPath
entities.description: The route a claim type must take: quantitative to reference comparison, legal to provision check, causal to study appraisal, qualitative to no-verification. Makes the differentiated handling explicit instead of one universal check.

entities.name: CausalSupport
entities.description: Appraisal of study evidence for a causal claim: study design, population, effect direction and whether it supports, contests or fails to address the claim.
